# Weekly status

1. Read the sprint board: what closed, what moved, what is blocked.
2. Write the report in the shape the report format below names, then compare every
   ticket number in it with the board, for example that `#412` is really closed.

## Report format

The skeleton, with every section in order, is [status.md](assets/status.md).
